main_system_reason: No openly available plan of Rakhigarhi draws Harappan walls, a fortification, streets or drains at measurable length with a north arrow.
notes: Examined and rejected (details and file hashes in measure-S/sources.json): (1) A. Nath, Excavations at Rakhigarhi [1997-98 to 1999-2000] (ASI draft report; Internet Archive excavationsatrakhigarhi19972000amarendranath_457_Z; the rarebooksocietyofindia.org copy has the same byte size): its drawn figures are trench sections (an RGR-2 section facing east, an RGR-1 section of trench K3 facing north and a section through a structure and pit), regional maps, soil and drainage maps and burial tables; structures appear only in photographs (Pls 4.1-4.6); the appendix Fig. 1 'Dispersal of mounds with contours' (PDF page index 335) is a contoured mound plan with an unlabelled north arrow, roads and field boundaries but no scale bar and no structures. (2) A. Nath, Purātattva 28 (1997-98) 'Rakhigarhi: A Harappan metropolis in the Sarasvati-Drishadvati divide' and Purātattva 31 (2000-01) 'Rakhigarhi: 1999-2000': site plans of mounds RGR-1 to RGR-7 marked 'not to scale', no structures; Purātattva 29 (1998-99) 'Further excavations at Rakhigarhi': text only. (3) Indian Archaeology 1997-98, 1998-99 and 1999-2000 - A Review, Rakhigarhi entries: photographic plates only (citadel walls, drains, platforms); no plan. IAR 2000-01 records only fencing of mounds I-III. (4) V. S. Shinde et al. 2018, PLoS ONE 13(2): e0192299: Fig. 2 an oblique aerial photograph, Fig. 3 a drone photograph of the RGR-7 cemetery trenches with a north arrow, Fig. 7 a grave plan of the necropolis; graves, not walls or streets. (5) V. Shinde and D. H. Shin (eds) 2023, New Perspectives on the Harappan Culture in Light of Recent Excavations at Rakhigarhi: 2011-2017, Vol. 1 (Archaeopress): not open access; the free sample holds Chapter 1 only, and the list of figures for Chapters 2-3 names photographs (drone views of RGR-1, RGR-2, RGR-4, RGR-6) rather than plans. (6) Shodhganga theses: the repository answers with an automated bot challenge (Anubis), which we did not attempt to pass. (7) Deccan College and ASI 2013-2016 and 2021-2024 seasons: we found press reports and university pages with photographs only; one press report states the direction of an RGR-1 street, which we did not use. Possible auxiliary plans if a structural plan appears later: Nath's contoured mound plan (report PDF page index 335) and the Purātattva 28 and 31 site plans, which show roads, the pond and the modern villages.
